useWhen: Building a new Android application from scratch
Adding a new feature to an existing Android app
Setting up Android architecture with best practices
Need to implement Jetpack Compose UI
Preparing an Android app for Play Store release

workflow.description: Set up MVVM or Clean Architecture with Hilt for dependency injection and Coroutines for async operations
Implement UI using Jetpack Compose with Material Design and Navigation components
Build core functionality, implement networking layer, and add local storage with Room database
Write tests, prepare for Play Store release, and configure release build

examples.input: Build an Android task management app with MVVM architecture
examples.output: Complete Android project with Hilt DI, Room database, Jetpack Compose UI, and MVVM pattern
examples.context: New Android project requiring Clean Architecture with proper separation of concerns

examples.input: Add offline sync capability to existing Android app
examples.output: Repository pattern with Room caching and WorkManager for background sync
examples.context: Existing Android app needs offline-first functionality
